sections.heading: 1. How to build it up
lines: ① Add one thing a week: distance, hills or pack.
② Walk two days in a row on weekends.
③ Step-ups and calf raises, 10 × 2 sets.
④ Break in new shoes well before you go.

sections.heading: 2. Stop and check first if…

items: Knees ache more as you walk

slides.title:
Meet Hybi at Hybrid Physio!
Book via the link in bio

caption:
Koko has a multi-day walk booked for a few months away. One day of walking feels fine, but day after day is a different story.

Walking fitness usually builds over weeks, not days. Big jumps in distance can leave you worn out and sore.

Hybi's prep: add one thing each week (distance, hills or pack weight), walk two days in a row on weekends, do step-ups and calf raises (10 × 2 sets), and break in new shoes well before you go.

If your knees ache more the further you walk, you've had a recent fall or your balance feels wobbly, it's worth a check before you leave. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 🥾

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
